content.prompt: Find the value of $x$ in the following.

spec.description: Right triangle with horizontal base, vertical right side, rising hypotenuse and a lower-right square angle marker.
spec.mathematics: Approved model A=(0,0), B=(8,0), C=(8,6), uniformly scaled. 8²+6²=10². Source labels x+3, x+1 and 10 are retained; no units are printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only original side labels and the right-angle mark appear.

answer.worked:
By Pythagoras,
$$\begin{align*}(x+3)^2+(x+1)^2&=10^2\\2x^2+8x+10&=100\\x^2+4x-45&=0\\(x+9)(x-5)&=0\\x&=-9\text{ or }x=5.\end{align*}$$
Reject $x=-9$ because side lengths must be positive. Hence $x=5$, giving sides $8$, $6$ and $10$.
